history.content: Hi, I have no signal on my phone at all. I can't make calls or send messages.

I can help you troubleshoot your signal issue. First, I need to identify your account to check for any line or account problems. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I’ll begin the troubleshooting process.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your line is currently suspended due to an overdue bill. To restore your service, you need to pay the overdue amount of $65.00 for your January bill.

I have sent you a payment request for this bill. Please check your payment requests and complete the payment. Once the payment is made, I will be able to resume your line and restore your signal. Let me know once you have completed the payment or if you need further assistance.

history.content: I have already rebooted my phone, but I still don't have any signal. The signal bars are empty.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your line is now active and you have already rebooted your phone, let’s continue troubleshooting your signal issue.

Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane mode icon (✈️)
- “No SIM” or “SIM error” message
- Any signal bars at all (even if they are empty)
- Any other icons or messages at the top of your screen

This information will help me determine the next steps to resolve your issue.
I now see excellent signal bars, 5G, and 'Connected to Chestnut-5G' in the status bar. Should I try sending a message or running a speed test to confirm everything is working?

That’s great news! Seeing excellent signal bars and 5G means your cellular service is restored. Since you’re also connected to Wi-Fi (“Chestnut-5G”), your phone should be able to use both mobile data and Wi-Fi.

To confirm everything is working:
- Try sending a text message or making a call to check your basic service.
- You can also run a speed test to check your internet connection quality.
- If you want to test mobile data specifically, you may want to temporarily turn off Wi-Fi and then run the speed test.

If you encounter any issues with calls, messages, or data, let me know and I’ll help you troubleshoot further. Otherwise, your service should be fully restored!
I ran a speed test, and everything looks excellent. My calls and messages are working too. Thank you for your help!
